articleTitle: Performance analysis of machine learning algorithms on diabetes dataset using big data analytics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: New Technologies such as Big Data and Cloud is playing a vital role in providing solutions to Healthcare problems. Now-a-days healthcare data is growing very drastically day-by-day and it requires an efficient, effective and timely solution to reduce the mortality rate. One of the most critical chronic healthcare problems is diabetes. In Long run, this problem may leads to damage eyes, heart, kidneys and nerves of diabetes patient if improper medication is done which also leads to death. The aim of this paper is to analyze and compare different machine learning algorithms to identify a best predicting algorithm based on various metrics such as accuracy, kappa, precision, recall, sensitivity and specificity. A comprehensive study is done on diabetes dataset with Random Forest (RF), SVM, k-NN, CART and LDA algorithms. The achieved results shows that RF is giving more accurate predictions with compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Internet of things: Architecture, security challenges and solutions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) is a large distributed network in which billion of devices are interconnected. It is considered to be the largest wave of resolution as it does not require human to machine interaction. However, with the rapid growth of IoT, challenges in terms of security have evolved as well. Since IoT consists of three layers perception layer, network layer and application layer, this paper will provide an analysis for various security problems at each layer including the cross-layer heterogeneous integration security issues and suggest some promising solutions.

articleTitle: Information model-based forecasting of technological process state
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Forecasting the quality of products is a complex task. The article introduces an approach based on the analysis of several technological operations. Such an analysis will yield a matrix of probable events. This matrix will become the basis for the analysis of the stability of the technological process and for predicting the quality of products.

articleTitle: Managing software product line using an ontological rule-based framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Feature model is amongst the widely used approach to manage variability and commonality in software product lines for enabling software reuse. Modeling variability and developing variable software products from feature model is an arduous task. Due to the growing complexity and size of feature models, defects such as false-optional and dead features can arise which lead to the development of low-quality erroneous software products. We propose an ontological rule-based framework that improves software product line by identifying feature model defects due to false-optional and dead features with their causes. This information further suggest corrections to the modelers for resolving defects. The evaluation results show the applicability of proposed framework to handle false-optional and dead features, and indicate its accuracy and scalability for huge size feature models with 21, 050 features. Thereby, improving the quality and reusability of software product line.

articleTitle: Malware detection in android mobile platform using machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Malware has always been a problem in regards to any technological advances in the software world. Thus, it is to be expected that smart phones and other mobile devices are facing the same issues. In this paper, a practical and effective anomaly based malware detection framework is proposed with an emphasis on Android mobile computing platform. A dataset consisting of both benign and malicious applications (apps) were installed on an Android device to analyze the behavioral patterns. We first generate the system metrics (feature vector) from each app by executing it in a controlled environment. Then, a variety of machine learning algorithms: Decision Tree, K Nearest Neighbor, Logistic Regression, Multilayer Perceptron Neural Network, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine are used to classify the app as benign or malware. Each algorithm is assessed using various performance criteria to identify which ones are more suitable to detect malicious software. The results suggest that Random Forest and Support Vector Machine provide the best outcomes thus making them the most effective techniques for malware detection.

articleTitle: Improved intelligent transport system for reliable traffic control management by adapting internet of things
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: As the population increases, vehicle usage has been increased considerably. Traffic becomes the most crucial factor at the time of traffic management which needs to be controlled for the improved traffic management. However traffic management would be more difficult task in case of increased vehicles usage by different number of peoples. Internet of Thing makes things easier by interconnecting vehicles with the server through the internet. IoT can monitor the vehicle periodically and track their location by sending periodic information to the server. This is focused in the proposed research framework by collecting and analyzing the traffic information so that traffic can be controlled very effectively. The significant target of this proposed framework is to carry out a novel IoT based Traffic Management (IoT-TM) that can make short term decision about the traffic management, thus the accurate and efficient traffic clearance can be achieved. In this research method, data set is gathered from the multiple traffic profiles which includes attributes such as time consumption, traffic rate, number of vehicles and so on. These data's would be learned in the training phase by using the Hybrid Artificial Neural Network with Hidden Markov Model (HANN-HMM) which can accurately learn the traffic profile information with reduced time. To perform accurate recognition of the traffic optimized feature selection is done before learning by using Hybrid Ant colony Glow worm swarm optimization approach. The complete interpretation of the aniticipated investigational framework has been conducted on MATLAB environment from which it is proved that the proposed research method namely IoT-TM can make better decision about the traffic management than the existing research systems.

articleTitle: Development of simulator for intrusion detection system to detect and alarm the DDoS attacks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: DDoS attacks are the major concern in the current digital world. Reducing the DDoS attacks is very hard especially when it comes to highly distributed Botnet-based attacks. It is necessary to detect these attacks early to protect end-users as well as the network infrastructure resources. The core of this work is to implement the Intrusion detection system (IDS) which is located at the Internet service providers (ISP) level. Using our self-developed simulation software, it will be shown that how ISPs form the protection rings around the host to collaborate and defend the traffic information.

articleTitle: A study on implementation of smart library systems using IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The research is intended to design a smart library management application for the libraries in Oman. The library is one of the important parts in any educational organization. Although, library has a system, but the library needs to implement a new management system in order to replace the existing system by introducing the new system. There are many reasons why the library staffs have to implement another system, which are: loss a lot of information on the library books. The loss of data about the books Difficulty in tracking down the details of the library transactions due to a slow system Difficulty in updating the information on regular basis. Proposed research project is to propose a smart solution for libaries in oman by designed an application which will be called as Smart library Management System by using the concepts of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and Mobile(IoT). The new system will manage and control all the information of the library and solve the above mention problems and as well as provide several benefits for the staff & students. This application includes several forms which will be used by the library staff and students. As a case the requirements have been gathered at Middle East College, Muscat, Oman Library and then the study is done.

articleTitle: A fuzzy interface system for determining Air Quality Index
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Delhi was declared the most polluted city in the world in 2014 by the world health organisation. There are three major sources of pollution in Delhi namely road dust, industry and vehicles. Majority of the pollution is caused by road dust and industries. The Air Quality Index(AQI) is the standardised way of describing the level of pollutants and overall air quality. AQI is dependent on the measurement of eight pollutants. The traditional method used is linear interpolation where only one pollutant is considered to calculate AQI. This paper proposes a fuzzy interface system for the calculation of AQI using two pollutants with each having six linguistic variables. The system gives satisfactory results and can provide many solutions for industrial air pollution.

articleTitle: Vitality of big data analytics in healthcare department
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Massive amount of data generation in recent past and leaving it all unutilized has created a great demand to visualize it for long-term benefits in healthcare industry. Working on the current issues of healthcare we gain an insight of diabetic patient, which are tremendously increasing in number from last few years. Coming up with a solution to hamper the growth of diabetic patient is itself a challenge. To overcome these challenges, Big Data Analytics played a vital role. This new treatment attitude orate us the greater demand for Big Data Analytics in healthcare utilities than ever before. In this paper we propose Big Data as an overwhelming opportunity for usage of huge data sets available for the end user. We also tend to focus on the issues, which emanated in the recent past years due to lack of data utilization, but also work on the ways to emancipate it in today's world.

articleTitle: Development of methods for business modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The article contains issues of quality management systems development, proposes a procedure for effective business planning, which allows ensuring integrity of the organization. The analysis of quality produced by the business process is carried out.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of student feedback system using Cronbach's alpha and Utility Measurement Process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Statistical Analysis of Student Feedback System Using Cronbach alpha and Utility Measurement Process is a statistical analysis that gives stage to any educational institute to lead under study's criticism. This framework is the best place to discover input answer as per the necessity of academics as well as infrastructure. Offline input of students to any educational institute is an essential element of powerful and proficient learning and educating. It can be one of the intense approaches to upgrade and fortify under study learning. This paper gives a reasonable investigation of criticism and audits the proof related to its effect on academics and infrastructure. This confirmation demonstrates that despite the fact that input is among the real impacts, the sort of criticism and the way it is given can be deferentially viable. At long last, this analysis is utilized to propose solutions in which input can be utilized to improve its effectiveness in any educational institute. The system which is implementing in this paper is a clear approach of assessing of student input for the betterment of educational institute. Selection process is a two-way process and this is reflected throughout this assessment. In selection processes educational organizations choose students, but students also choose an educational organization. If selection is to be effective then both of these processes must be working effectively. After some discourse the paper will introduce some valuable appraisal and assessment procedures which can help dialect educators to make a preferred educational institute for students.

articleTitle: Remote based patient monitoring system using wearable sensors through online and offline mode for android based mobile platforms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: People need health care services to be done and maintained on a regular basis. Complications arise as they wear the sensor-based health monitoring devices. Although Health monitoring devices are affordable, monitoring them complicates the equipment along with its usage. Multiple modalities such as the heart rate and pulse rate, body temperature, blood pressure also can be sensed with the help of sensors and those data's can also be stored for future monitoring and analysis process. Though the possibility is there in every aspect to monitor; there are complications which exist to be resolved. Few unresolved queries exist such as helping the blind people by themselves, capturing the high and low-level pressure and storing it in the database, initiating the person nearby to utilizing the first aid kid, advise the public to assist the patient, identifying and send an emergency alert tracking the location through GPS. The collected and stored data will help the patients to utilize for further usage. The means to resolve the problem are analyzed, and a methodology is proposed.

articleTitle: Tweet normalization: A knowledge based approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Twitter Sentiment Analysis has attracted a lot of attention recently due to its promising commercial advantages. Data pre-processing is a leading and fundamental step towards sentiment analysis since it may lead to increase the correctly classified instance. The occurrence of slangs, misspelled words, hashtags, URLs, emoticons etc. in tweets make Twitter text notoriously noisy and unstructured thus sentiment analysis of Twitter text is a challenging task. So focus of this paper is to highlight pre-processing significance that would normalize and clean tweets for sentiment classification fortification. In this research work, we explore various pre-processing methods and presented a framework of the pre-processing system with a detailed description of the process which comprises of 2 segments: denoising such as removal of StopWords, URLs, username, punctuation etc. and normalization such as conversion of Non-standard words to their canonical forms. Tweets are pre-processed by normalizing elongated words (loooove to looove), misspelled words (kkk to okay), informal acronyms (rofl to rolling on the floor laughing), negation handling, emoticon replacement, etc. An evaluation is also carried out for analyzing the performance of the pre-processing system by comparison of manually pre-processed tweets and automatic pre-processed tweets and report 87.6% accuracy of proposed pre-processing method on 1000 tweets of demonetization, 90.5% accuracy on 200 tweets of iphone7 and 88.08% combined accuracy on 1200 tweets (1000 of demonetization and 200 of iphone7).

articleTitle: Security solutions for physical layer of IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In today's scenario, the most trending technology that is existing in the society is Internet of Things. The whole concept of IoT attracts and motivates techies to create more exiting applications that makes life easy. The domain that contains the fields where IOT is used is very broad. But the major factor which acts as a limitation for IOT is security. The whole concept of IoT revolves around machine-to-machine communication. Machine captures some data and then performs some sort of analysis on it and finally triggers another machine to perform some action accordingly. The data that these machines capture can be private and highly confidential. Hence the security at each layer of IoT is must as the security breach can lead to severe consequences. For an instance, if the security gets compromised at the very first layer i.e. physical layer, then the whole concepts of IoT puts the privacy of the individuals or organisations about whom data is being captured at stake. So, this paper proposes some feasible, low cost and security boosting methodologies to secure the physical layer of IoT.

articleTitle: Predicting crowdfunding success with optimally weighted random forests
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The social media version of fundraising, crowdfunding has, within a very short time, become an important and often critical element of the process that allows budding entrepreneurs to grow in todays market. While the underlying principle behind crowdfunding - to get multiple people to financially back an idea and collectively amass enough resources to make it happen - is simple enough in theory, it is much harder to actually implement. Kickstarter, the largest and most well-known crowdfunding website internationally, sees more than half of the uploaded projects rejected due to inadequate funds gathered. In this study, we take a closer look at the reasons for success and failure of these projects from the project description pages, where the creators attempt to persuade potential backers into supporting their respective creations. A dataset of over 26 thousand Kickstarter projects was created and used to understand the factors that most affect the chances of acquiring successful funding. In this study, we propose a novel algorithm for the RandomForests learning model in which we assign optimal weights to the individual classifiers and perform weighted majority voting on them using the 13 predictors that were found to be most suitable through implementation logic. These predictors will serve to be useful to both, a project creator as well as a potential backer, in order to devote their energy and resources judiciously. Finally, we tested our optimized learning model on the freshly acquired dataset and observed 94.289% accuracy, 94.5% precision, 94.3% recall and 94.3% F-measure value in success prediction. This research achieved the best accuracy and greatest amount of success in this field.

articleTitle: Building an effective recommender system using machine learning based framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Machine learning forms the base of many information retrieval applications those effect our day to day lives directly or indirectly. One of the Commonly used application of machine learning algorithms is Recommender Systems. Recommender system are information flitering system which takes users rating for items into account and predict user preferences. Many online ecommerce and other categorical websites are able to generate recommendations either on the basis of implicit feedback or explicit feedback. In implicit feedback, preferences are actually based on analysis of browsing patterns of the user, for example, purchase history, web logs etc. Explicit feedback is generated from the ratings provided by the user. In this paper we have shown adaption of collaborative filtering in Apache Mahout platforms via Eclipse on a sample data set.

articleTitle: USSD — Architecture analysis, security threats, issues and enhancements
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Services Data) is a real-time session oriented technology, used to provide mobile based network and banking services with/without Internet using USSD codes over GSM channel. For banking services using USSD, the Mobile Network Operator (MNO) is used as an interface between the customer and his respective bank. USSD is an user interactive menu driven, cheaper and faster solution and is better than SMS w.r.t to cost, security and channel usage (as SMS uses voice channel always, whereas USSD uses voice channel normally and resorts to a separate channel only when it is busy). It is platform independent, available in multiple regional languages and does not require any software download. USSD is considered as a better choice for non-smartphone users of rural community to avail network services and bank payment solutions. Additional security enhancements in USSD shall make it the best choice and extend its use further. To do security enhancements in USSD, it is necessary to understand its architecture, its benefits, threats and issues. This paper presents the details on USSD architecture, benefits, threats and proposes possible security enhancements in the same to improve the USSD based mobile banking application information security.

articleTitle: Efficient random data accessing in MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The voluminous data can not be handled using traditional serial programming methods. It needs to be dealt effectively using parallel programming methods in a distributed environment. Emerging technologies for parallel processing has been changing the concept of programming, storage and operating system in distributed environment. Grid Computing and MapReduce technologies have been proven very handy in processing huge volume of simple and multi-dimensional data. The MapReduce in the Hadoop provides an abstract environment for parallel processing of jobs. The framework is well-known for its data analysis capability. However, it is efficient for sequential read and writes. It does not show good performance for random read and writes. It is so because the Hadoop is based on the key-value storage concept and does not work on any indexed dataset. A lot of work has been done to improve the performance of the Hadoop. Indexing input dataset in the Hadoop is one such area. In this paper, a B-Tree index construction process in traditional programming environment is described and a conceptual idea of realizing it in the MapReduce-Hadoop is presented.

articleTitle: A secure IoT-based power plant control using RSA and DES encryption techniques in data link layer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The rapid amplifying improvement in the field of Internet control gives rise to an imminent vision where different sectors even in industries are advancing towards the fields in where clients, processing systems, control and instrumentation units or any other systems possess logic and triggering competence, which collaborate with extraordinary expediency and provide reasonable advances. This is the part of the cause that the Industrial sector is formulating a turnover in the field of Internet of Things (IoT) where communications between devices is through the Internet in broad and thus as a result of this technological breakthrough, even the Power Plant sectors can behold remotely controlled operations in addition to remotely monitored operations without the physical location being an essential to control and monitor these Power Plants. Since security is going to be an elementary factor here, methods must be formulated to safeguard such communications in control systems while they transmit data through Internet (Public Channels). This paper proposes using RSA and DES encryption techniques in order to encrypt data frames to take in consideration the security issues. The data used is provided by NTPC, India and the simulation is performed using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Development of methodology for assessing risk of loss of a consumer through the fault of an outsourcer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Assessment of risk of loss of a consumer through the fault of an outsourcer is considered in this article. To evaluate the quality of the outsourcer's work, it is suggested to use the criterion - the probability of loss of the consumer. If this probability is very high, then such an outsourcer should be discarded. The organization needs to know how outsourcing affects the consumer's opinion, since the consumer does not differentiate between the product of the producer and the outsourcer.

articleTitle: Predicting dynamic modulus for bituminous concrete using support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Absolute value of complex modulus is dynamic modulus. Complex modulus of bituminous mixes is a key parameter used in mechanistic design approach of flexible pavements. Performance of bituminous mix including fatigue cracking and rutting in flexible pavement also depends upon its complex modulus. Therefore, in order to better understand behavior and performance of flexible pavements, assessment of complex modulus of bituminous mixes is inevitable. It is well understood that complex modulus of bituminous mixtures are function of temperatures and loading frequencies. Laboratory investigation of complex modulus requires sophisticated equipments, tedious time consuming experimentation and intricate computation work, which encourages modeling techniques. In the recent past researchers have developed models for predicting dynamic modulus of bituminous mixes using finite element (FE), artificial neural network (ANN) and regression-based techniques. However, limited models have been developed for Indian temperature condition and bitumen grades. In the present study, dynamic modulus of bituminous concrete (BC) using artificial neural network (ANN) and support vector regression (SVR) based modeling approach has been developed. The dataset consisting of 80 measurements derived from an earlier study was used. As the choice of the methods affects the performance of a machine learning algorithms and may influence the accuracy of the final model, thus three methods for model testing were used to evaluate the effectiveness of SVR modeling technique in predicting dynamic modulus of bituminous concrete. Analysis of results indicates a comparable performance by (i) 10-fold cross validation and (ii) LOOV method in terms of correlation coefficient and means absolute error values. In random division method choice of a random number affect the model performance. This study may be helpful in fair estimation of the dynamic modulus value for bituminous concrete at different temperature and load frequencies prevailing in India.

articleTitle: Forecasting PV power from solar irradiance and temperature using neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Energy is an important aspect in the today's world. Due to the increase in the population and the decrease in oil and other energy resources the power generation using renewable energy has become more popular. Due to the increase in power demand at the power station the forecasting becomes very essential to meet the demand on the daily basis. The amount of power generated depends on solar irradiance, temperature and weather forecast of future. Since there are uncertainties in the forecast it is essential to have very good forecasting techniques to predict the power at the grid stations. In this paper neural network has been used to predict the power generation from the metrological data. In this paper backpropagation algorithm is used for the prediction. The paper presents the forecasting the power and the feasibility analysis of PV system using a grid connected system. In this paper real data from a solar power plant in India is used for analysis. RET screen software has been used for the climatic conditions like humidity, temperature with the radiations. Neural networks model is designed to forecast the power that will be generated for the solar irradiation and the temperature.

articleTitle: An analytical evaluation of challenges in Green cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a cost efficient infrastructure enterprise. Its demand has increased the energy consumption of data centers drastically. This is becoming a serious issue. Therefore, It need green cloud computing solutions to save energy and reduce operational costs and carbon emission which is not friendly for the environment. Hence, energy-efficient solutions should be used to reduce its effect. In order to achieve this, enough knowledge of cloud is required. Basically our main business is to implicate the solution to enable the future research on green cloud computing. This paper will give the idea that how cloud users can be useful to achieve this goal. This paper also discusses the benefits of Green Cloud Computing and also deals with the various aspects to reduce the energy consumption by cloud computing and reduce the carbon dioxide level. This paper also includes factors supporting the need for green cloud computing and the features of the cloud which enable green computing. Further in the paper, challenges faced are explained and a little explanation of green cloud architecture is also given.

articleTitle: Prediction of aviation accidents using logistic regression model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Aircraft engine and airplanes are highly reliable, that it is nearly impossible that a pilot may experience any airplane causality in his job carrier. Aircraft crashes only occur due human negligence. Sensors and control systems are installed on an airplane to give information about each and every component. Data generated and collected for various causes of accidents can be analysed and used for prediction of any situation which can cause and incident or accident. In this paper we have proposed and general linear model to predict the possible accident, using various input parameters taken from aviation data. Logistic Regression model is applied on the data and prediction analysis is done. The results of the proposed model are very stimulating in terms of predictive analysis.

articleTitle: Inspection of cloud computing monitoring tools
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Cloud monitoring activity includes dynamically capturing the Quality of Service (QoS), the physical assets they share, the data hosted on them and the apps running on them. Considering a large amount of heterogeneous cloud resources, applications and resources are quite challenging in cloud computing environment. Also consider the fact that at each point of time, there will be specific and different cloud service. Therefore the application developer or cloud providers are assisted by a cloud monitoring tools in the following way: i) make sure that the application is at its peak efficiency; ii) Resource and application performances are checked in variations; iii) Qos (Quality of Service) parameters of certain Service Level Agreement (SLA) violations have been accounted; iv) The join and leave operations of cloud resources have been tracked because of Dynamic configuration changes and failure. In this paper, Design issues and major research dimensions related to monitoring tools of cloud are identified and discussed. Furthermore a brief study of various tools is provided.

articleTitle: Agent based solution for dining philosophers problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Dining philosophers problem is a typical example of inter process synchronization problem where various resources need to be allocated between different processes to avoid deadlock as well as starvation. There are different solutions are proposed but they have few limitations. This paper proposes an agent based solution wherein an agent will grant the permission to acquire and release the resources (i.e. chopsticks). An agent will be added to the system. The agent will release a TOKEN to a philosopher to begin a state like Eating, Thinking or Waiting. The purpose is to obtain a deadlock and starvation free solution to the problem.

articleTitle: Game-theory based detection and prevention of DoS attacks on networking node in open stack private cloud
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Security at virtualization level has always been a major issue in cloud computing environment. A large number of virtual machines that are hosted on a single server by various customers/client may face serious security threats due to internal/external network attacks. In this work, we have examined and evaluated these threats and their impact on OpenStack private cloud. We have also discussed the most popular DOS (Denial-of-Service) attack on DHCP server on this private cloud platform and evaluated the vulnerabilities in an OpenStack networking component, Neutron, due to which this attack can be performed through rogue DHCP server. Finally, a solution, a game-theory based cloud architecture, that helps to detect and prevent DOS attacks in OpenStack has been proposed.

articleTitle: Active learning and student engagement using Activity Based Learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This research aims to induce Activity Learning into Network Administration module to enhance student engagement and learning experience at Middle East College, Computing Department. The research is to include Active Learning in Network Administration module and find the relation between active learning and student engagement. Skills acquired by the students in the involved process of active learning. Outlining the Activity Based Learning into practice and observes its impact on the teaching and learning process.

articleTitle: Improved differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Differential Evolution (DE) is an evolutionary approach to unravel complex optimization problems. The DE is a straight forward and very popular population based stochastic Algorithm. DE outperformed other competitive evolutionary algorithms when measured over benchmark problem as well as actual optimization problems in terms of performance. The major drawback of DE is early convergence and stagnation at sub-optimal points, like other stochastic optimization algorithms. So as to overcome these problems this paper presents hybrid of DE with levy flight search strategy. The anticipated algorithm tested over a set of benchmark problems to demonstrate its superiority over other popular modification of DE.

articleTitle: Evaluating quality of adhesive joint of missile radomes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The article suggests quality evaluating technique for adhesive joints of missile radomes based on FMEA analysis. The criteria for selecting of coefficients for calculation of priority number of risks have been developed. Modification of Cpk capability index is proposed in the quality of changes in quantitative characteristics of adhesive joints.

articleTitle: Advanced patient matching: Recognizable patient view for decision support in healthcare using big data analytics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Like Air, The whole world is bounded by the data in the current day. The volume of open information and data explosion, Healthcare industries in on a critical moment. Here Big Data plays an important role for these new changes in health care. Nowadays Healthcare industries are suffering from many problems because of data growth is speedily growing day by day. Healthcare decision support systems necessity a recognizable view of the patients for making the efficient decision against the patients and offer a better diagnosis and treatment. Patient pattern matching and identification is one of the biggest challenges in integrate to electronic healthcare record (EHR). The health care systems have the diverse document and result from unrelated systems like pharmacy, clinical, laboratory, insurance etc. we need to be matched with the fair patient record. This paper emphasizes on the challenge of patient matching records from diverse systems and offers a solution using Big Data analytic and pattern matching algorithm like Fuzzy Algorithm.

articleTitle: Opportunistic message forwarding in self organized cluster based DTN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs) is that class of challenged network that works on existing infrastructure. Any two nodes that move within each other's transmission range can exchange messages. This may form the basis for future forwarding based on past contact history. Based on these identifiable patterns one may predict contacts in near future. Some existing schemes use utility functions to steer the routing in the right direction but are limited, and is unable to capture enough information of the network. In this paper, the Trust Model is further extended to identify cluster heads in DTN environment that results in the optimal utilization of the node's resources. Due to high network mobility, it is assumed that the node's contacts are unpredictable so that it can reflect the most efficient way of message movement. Further, the identification of the cluster head enhances delivery ratio and reduces delivery latency. Fewer messages are aborted in case of proposed algorithm as compared to FirstContact. There is 7.7% reduction in the number of messages in the network as compared to FirstContact routing protocol. The proposed routing protocol is simulated using real-world mobility traces. Also, the minimum hop count is observed that leads to lesser overhead. The proposed work demonstrates the applicability of the trust to compute and forward the message to DTN's using cluster head. This implicitly applies security to an acceptable level. Experimental work shows research direction towards resource optimization in DTN network.

articleTitle: Drones take-off towards legal regime in the United Arab Emirates
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Unmanned Ariel vehicles are very exciting for all, and can be used by anyone; it provides a new perspective to the modern world. Misuse of drone's leads to warfare then epitomizes altogether different effect and possibly followed uncontrolled threat to society at large. UAE have been coming up with regulation to restrict and monitor the use of non-commercial usage on emerging technologies. The paper aims to address regulation, requirements, restriction, and to discuss legislation on civil aviation and flight activities on drones.

articleTitle: Diffusion of industry 4.0 in manufacturing sector — An innovative framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: With new technologies emerging out in the manufacturing sector everyday moving away from the traditionally adopted mechanical systems to one of the most sophisticated and automated assembly lines of today. To meet and adopt to the dynamic customer requirements, fourth generation of industrial manufacturing governed by smart systems and web based solutions called industry 4.0 is considered to be the technology for the future. The two prime distinguishing features of Industry 4.0 involves digitization by use of cyber-physical systems and manufacturing units enabled with human like intelligence based on the concept of “internet of things”. This research work proposes a framework to help identify various enablers of industry 4.0 adoption in European manufacturing companies; design and test a model under the premises of the theories of Diffusion of Innovation and Organizational Diffusion of Innovation for improving our knowledge and understanding about the adoption of industry 4.0 in future amongst the European manufacturers; and, to explain the effect of industry 4.0 adoption on the performance of a manufacturing company.

articleTitle: Next-best-view planning for environment exploration and 3D model construction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Smart robotics platforms in human environments usually develop a complete model of the surrounding environment. Exploring and modelling the environment required planning of best view positions as well as a navigation strategy that assure completeness and high quality of the construed model. In this paper, we describe a next-best-view planning for a mobile robot with limited sensors capability to explore and construct a 3D model of an indoor environment. Starting with a 2D occupancy grid map, the proposed algorithm shall process this map and generate candidates view poses. Next, the algorithm shall select the set of best views and generate a navigation plan of RGB-D sensor poses while satisfying a set of constrains in order to maximize the quality of the 3D constructed model and coverage of the indoor environment. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness and validity of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Data synchronization and offloading techniques for energy optimization in mobile cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Mobile devices have become primary computational platforms for many users. The prime constraints include storage and battery life. Energy saving can be provided as a service to mobile users via Mobile Cloud Computing. Offloading mobile applications to mobile cloud is one of the ways to conserve energy. Under this, heavy computations are performed remotely on the cloud, thereby reducing the energy utilization and enhancing the applications performance. But offloading must be applied only on certain selected applications based on their profiles, instead of offloading all the applications for better performance and energy savings. Moreover a continuous sync between mobile device and cloud results in high-energy requirement. Synchronization to cloud must be based on certain validations to improve efficiency and resource utilization.

articleTitle: Allocating resource dynamically in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In Cloud Computing, properly utilizing resource allocation dynamically is one of the most important factors for optimization. While utilizing, the main focus is on to use maximum resources which are highly scalable so that the process is completed in a speedy manner. In today's world exploring various algorithm and developing our own more efficient algorithm is desired for the advancement of technology. Similarly, this paper focuses on analyzing two similar algorithms and thereafter proposing a new composite algorithm which focuses on maximizing the throughput of the cloud provider. This proposed algorithm is derived from teaching learning based optimization algorithm (TLBO) and grey wolves optimization algorithm (GW). This algorithm works more efficient in utilizing each of these algorithms. Moreover, it balances time and cost and also tries to avoid local optimization trap which ultimately makes the waiting time minimum. In order to justify its effectiveness we have conducted few experiments and then compared them.

articleTitle: Development of external customer classification based on the analysis of interested parties
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In the article introduced new classification of consumers. For modern quality management, it is important to understand the requirements of the consumer. In case of participation of outsourcers in the production processes, it is necessary to change the existing classification of consumers. This change is necessary because the outsourcer cannot directly interact with the consumer, whereas the consumer interacts with the producer. Consequently, there is another link for interaction between customer and outsourcer that is the manufacturer. Because of this link, it is possible to lose the customer's requirements, which the outsourcer must fulfill. Therefore, we can say that there is a new type of consumer — “concealed customer”.

articleTitle: Detection of human gait cycle: An overlap based approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel and efficient human gait cycle detection method is proposed. Based on the number of leg overlapping, the correct sequence of gait cycle and the number of possible gait cycles for a subject are calculated. CASIA B human gait dataset is chosen for gait cycle detection. This simple and efficient gait cycle detection method is helpful to researchers in this era to overcome the challenges for better feature extraction and recognition performance.

articleTitle: Opinion mining using ontological spam detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In the current scenario, the data on the web is growing exponentially. Social media is generating a large amount of data such as reviews, comments, and customers' opinions on a daily basis. This huge amount of user generated data is worthless unless some mining operations are applied to it. As there are a number of fake reviews so opinion mining technique should incorporate Spam detection to produce a genuine opinion. Nowadays, there are a number of people using social media opinions to create their call on shopping for product or service. Opinion Spam detection is an exhausting and hard problem as there are many faux or fake reviews that have been created by organizations or by the people for various purposes. They write fake reviews to mislead readers or automated detection system by promoting or demoting target products to promote them or to or to degrade their reputations. In this paper, the proposed technique includes ontology, Geo location and IP address tracking, Spam words Dictionary using Naïve Bayes, Brand only review detection and tracking account used. Experimental results dictate its better results over its nearest competitors.

articleTitle: Development of the internal audit procedure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This article considers the problem of enhancing the effectiveness of internal audit procedures for quality management systems. Internal audit is an obligatory procedure of the international standard ISO 9001. The article studies the matter of the effectiveness of this procedure. To do so, an analysis of auditors' works was conducted, and several models of the internal audit procedure were proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A study for improving energy efficiency in mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Energy efficiency is increasingly importantfor mobile devices. This paper represents a review of existing techniques for mobile devices and present a new approach that makes a mobile device last longer. This is done by increasing the battery capacity in the same physical space and by enhancing the circuit board. This study overcomes few problems that cause the mobile device to lose its efficiency. This paper also shows the environmental friendly materials for the framework that can be recycled, which will helps in reducing the waste material.

articleTitle: Efficient approach towards bitcoin security algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Bitcoin is the most popular cryptocurrency in the market at this time. A crypto currency is a kind of currency which has no physical form, but rather only works over the internet. This also means that there are a lot of vulnerabilities in this form of money transaction. The purpose of this paper is to explore some of these issues as well as suggest ways in which we can keep bitcoin secure.

articleTitle: Political opinion mining using E-social network data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In view of the fact that an exponential growth in social networks is observed in last two decades. The opinion of the people about any political or non-political issues are now directly affected by the information shared on these social media. In any democratic nation the winning of any political party in general elections can be ensure depending upon its popularity on the electronic social networks, where large quantity of messages are shared in every unit of the time. Data available on the these social networking sites can be used for the forecasting the popularity of the political parties regular bases. In this paper, a simple logistic data model is applied on the data collected from Twitter, facebook and other media during the time of elections and opinion can be analyzed based classification of data on bases of high and low popularity parties during elections. The results of our data model are very stimulating and good for the analysis.

articleTitle: An end to end security framework for service oriented architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Service Oriented Architecture has emerged as effective model and widely acceptable for distributed application development. To meet enterprises dynamics, SOA provides better functionalities but along with better functionality, SOA introduces security challenges which was not an issue with single hop client server architecture. Using SOA standards of distributed deployment, it is difficult for user to ensure that the deployment of each services is appropriately secure. Services are building blocks of SOA which provides better flexibility, reusability, composability making application building activity easier. Consumers are not interested only in SOA functionality but also in quality, reliability, security, performance and so on. SOA enables the design of flexible and modular software applications that can be used in a cross-organization context but these quality requirements may have a negative impact on the security of the software application. Several security standards like web service security standards and WS security policy have been adopted in recent years but these are not sufficient to provide end to end security to the SOA based project. After the survey, the authors found many security techniques have been suggested for SOA in past years but almost all are limited to higher level of service oriented architecture only. In this paper, the authors propose a framework which has enhanced security concepts by security implementation both at higher and lower level. This will increase security at service level. Also, it will be helpful in enhancing the security for service deployment. The authors have also suggested a technique to keep service level agreement time same as existing SLAs, so that secured applications can be used with same response time as provided to the customer for existing services. The proposed implementation will increase the software reliability by securing the application end to end.

articleTitle: Modelling fault detection with change-point in agile software development environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: On behest of the customer a software system should be designed in a way that it goes along parallel with the present user needs. New algorithms acts as guiding light for the persistently needed attention to the softwares. A software should be able to cater the rapidly changing needs & requirements of users. A satisfied user is a manifestation of a good approach & implementation of a much pragmatic way. User's requirements evolve over time with quick changing market needs which needs to be attended dynamically. This led to adopt an approach of agile to be adopted which is based on `lean' principles over the traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) approach. Collaborative work done with the project team leads a well-documented priority list of the needs. The implementation is done through “SCRUM” an empirical framework for learning. It has multiple sprints which is a deliverable product. This idea has substantially created a reduction in the `time to market' as the customer can decide which features of the software they would like to be delivered on a priority basis. To do the modelling of trends of fault detection in each sprint, a growth model of software reliability is used.

articleTitle: Selection of framework for implementing agile in software industry by fuzzy AHP approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Agile Framework assortment is one of the essential parts of a product association. To select the right system for skilled corporation helps to spare expenses and guarantee on - time product delivery, which likewise meets the customers' prerequisite and fulfillment. Despite the fact that this choice ends up noticeably muddled if there should be an occurrence of a few systems and different clashing criteria. Likewise the instability and ambiguity of the specialists' sentiment is the noticeable normal for the issue. Thus a generally used multi criteria Fuzzy AHP is implemented via application for this issue. This paper uncovers utilization of Fuzzy AHP in a product organization deciding the best system as per selected criteria. It contributes to the approach of Fuzzy AHP method for agile framework selection. Moreover, by expressing Fuzzy AHP comprehensively and numerally, this paper also finds the best possible framework for agile that should be executed for various criteria decision making issues.

articleTitle: Approach to analysis of certification authorities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This article considers the selection of companies that provide services of quality management systems certification. The choice of companies for product certification is a very important decision that will affect the reputation of the organization. To select such a company, it is necessary to take into account a large number of indicators. The article suggests thirteen indicators that will help organizations choose the right company for certification of the quality management system.

Author Keywords: indicators for assessment of certification authorities

articleTitle: Cloud attenuation model at millimeter frequency bands
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: With the exponential growth of technology in satellite communications, the need of high bandwidth is increasing. For the support of high end services and applications higher frequency bands are required. The major limitations for higher frequencies like mm wave are attenuation due to gas, clouds, fog and rain. For satellite communications cloud attenuation plays significant role because of complex structure of clouds. In this paper different aspect of clouds with respect to cloud attenuation is discussed and a theoretical model for cloud attenuation is presented.

articleTitle: Map matching approach for current location tracking on the road network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In Modern Era, many researchers are working to upgrade real time position tracking systems. Tracking systems fully depend on an appropriate road network and reliability of tracking vehicle data. The map matching concept provides intersection links between road segments. Map matching performance depends on GPS trajectory, but, it is unreliable due to weak GPS signalling issues such as atmospheric delay, multipath signalling, and ionospheric delay in the Indian mass. GPS Aided GEO Augmentation System (GAGAN) provides reliable signals services for correct positioning finding in the Indian mass. This work proposed map matching algorithm that computing closest point on the road network and also addresses the challenge of real time position mapping including position techniques.

articleTitle: Elliptic curve cryptography: A dynamic paradigm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The paper focuses on elliptic curve cryptography technique using dynamic approach. The expression proposed in this technique cannot be determined with ease which significantly improves the security of this proposed algorithm to a very high level. A user input is responsible for generating the equation of ECC dynamically.

articleTitle: A critical analysis on integration of fog computing and cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Today smart phone devices main concern is storage as well as long lasting battery backup. On a great extend energy saving solutions on devices are at the edge of technology. In cellular communication, the quick battery drain in smart phone is due to the push services required in keep-alive connections those are used to notify users for incoming messages. Mostly keep-alive connections led to drain smart phone battery on rapidly sending packets in communication system. Previously no attention was drawn towards the energy consumption on high rate of keep-alive connection during push services provided in smart phone devices. Fog computing is similar to cloud computing but on the other hand it is the extension of cloud computing and services to the edge of network. It provides data compute storage and application services to end users. In this paper we prefer SCoP that is Single Connection Proxy system, that is based on fog computing principles that combines several keep-alive connections in one unit and push messages in energy saving form. SCoP prevents in smart phone high energy consumption for both real-time and delay-tolerate applications. The new design of SCoP is a transparent connection between smart phone and push servers, without any change in push service framework. SCoP system reduce the energy consumption by 50% depending upon the application, that is, 30% less energy in real time applications than current push service also 60% less energy for delay tolerate applications.

articleTitle: Audio steganography using ASCII code and GA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: As information sharing over the internet has been increased has raised the problem of security of digital data on the device as well as the communication channel through which the information is shared. Many techniques have been used so far to secure the valuable data and steganography is one of them. It is a technique used to conceal the secret data within a normal appearing cover media i.e. it makes the secret message almost invisible for any unwanted recipient. To make our steganography algorithm more secure, here we are encoding the secret data into its ASCII and then GA is Applied to the audio samples of cover file in order to get an optimum position to hide the data, after this LSB is used to embed the ASCII codes of the secret data.

articleTitle: Interpretive structural modelling in assessment of agile methodology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Changing trends and globalization has given rise to various challenges to the software industry. In today's scenario software engineering is related to its quality and timely delivery of product to keep in pace with the new expertise and changing market condition. Thus, Interpretive Structural Modelling (ISM) is a methodology for interactive learning process which is a deep-rooted and has been increasingly used by various researchers to represent the interrelationships among various attributes and their related issues. ISM approach starts with an identification of attributes, which are relevant to the problem or issue. Having decided the contextual relation, a structural self-interaction matrix (SSIM) is developed based on pairwise comparison of variables. Which is then converted into a reachability matrix (RM) and its transitivity is checked. It is necessary to analyze the performance of the various attributes for their operative applications in the execution of software development process. The main objective of this paper is to identify the communication of these attributes and identify the dependent attributes. This paper focuses on the ISM model to recognize significant attributes and their organizational consequences from software release time point of view.

articleTitle: Hybridization of artificial neural network and lagrange multiplier method to solve economic load dispatch problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Lagrange multiplier method also known as λ-iteration method has been in use to find the solution of the economic load dispatch problem for many years. Though it produces results with great accuracy but it suffers from the disadvantage of convergence as it is highly sensitive to the initial value of λ and at times takes more time to produce results. To overcome this drawback, in this paper an innovative technique to solve the ELD problem, by hybridization of artificial neural network (ANN) and LMM is proposed. To formulate the problem, generation cost is expressed as a function of active power by exponential functions. The equality constraint of power balance and inequality constraint that fix the maximum and minimum active power are duly considered. ANN trained by backpropagation algorithm is used to find the optimal value of λ which is then used to find solutions using LMM. Training data, i.e., input and target patterns for ANN are obtained by LMM. Using proposed hybrid method, λ-iterations are eliminated and promising results are obtained in much less computation time. Hence, the proposed method can be useful in real time solution for seeking online solution of ELD problems.

articleTitle: Vulnerability prediction through self-learning model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Vulnerability being the buzz word in the modern time is the most important jargon related to software and operating system. Since every now and then, software is developed some loopholes and incompleteness lie in the development phase, so there always remains a vulnerability of abruptness in it which can come into picture anytime. Detecting vulnerability is one thing and predicting its occurrence in the due course of time is another thing. If we get to know the vulnerability of any software in the due course of time then it acts as an active alarm for the developers to again develop sound and improvised software the second time. The proposal talks about the implementation of the idea using the artificial neural network, where different data sets are being given as input for being used for further analysis for successful results. As of now, there are models for studying the vulnerabilities in the software and networks, this paper proposal in addition to the current work, will throw light on the predictability of vulnerabilities over the due course of time.

articleTitle: Routing optimization by minimizing one-way delay in delay tolerant enabled vehicular ad-hoc networks using ferry selection approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: An existing approach “FFRDV” performs well without consideration of high speed vehicles in the traffic i.e. comparatively higher speed vehicles wrt speed of Current Ferry (CF) are not available in the network and all nearby vehicles are considered as of same category. In this research paper, a new idea for selection of a proper ferry to forward the information is developed which takes into account the type of ferries & current speed of ferries and is based on fastest ferry. The election for highest speed ferry during variable size blocks take it towards robustness to handover high speed vehicles which minimize one-way delay and maximize PDF. This may be used to prevent the accidents and to call emergency services. The advantage of proposed algorithm over existing approaches is validated by the results obtained by MATLAB. The proposed scheme minimizes the end-to-end delay and thus a message can be arrive at destination early which in turn saves many accidents and thus saves lives and money.

articleTitle: The study of data analytics in inventory management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In this paper, the areas where Data Analytical (DA) tools can be applied in the domain of Supply Chain Management (SCM), specifically in inventory management are illuminated. Paper shows the practical usage of programming language R to implement the Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) on a large inventory data set to find the dependencies. Further the study is elaborated by implementing ABC analysis on the data set. Implementing these models, measures have been suggested which could be taken to ease the inventory management. This paper suggests that DA tools can be a significant part of inventory management.

articleTitle: Hydra — Anonymous network routing mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Anonymous network routing mechanisms are an epitome of network security to securely transmit data over a network. Example: Onion routing, Garlic routing. It's a foolproof mechanism to route data packets across the network with supposed source and destination anonymity, along with end-to-end encryption of data and provide protection from eave-droppers, surveilling government agencies, hackers and similar unwanted agencies. Except that these existing mechanisms are NOT completely fool-proof. And this paper will explain how along with introducing a considerably better mechanism.

articleTitle: Application and use of MCDM technique in software industry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This examination investigates the product creation/up gradations variables of enterprises by applying the Decision Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) technique. Established on the writing audits, three critical points of view and eight criteria were removed and after that approved by industry specialists. During the time spent approval a survey was made and answered by specialists. At that point the DEMATEL strategy was connected to investigate the significance of criteria and the easy-going relations among the criteria were built. The outcome demonstrated that the vital point of view was the most imperative viewpoint and affected the rest of the points of view. This work additionally displays the critical criteria for every point of view. DEMATEL strategy can affirm interrelationships among differing factors and recognize the key elements. In initial step, every unique factor are distinguished and ordered, and after that utilizing a survey, related components are recorded. The causal model distinguishes the primary driver and impacts. DEMATEL technique indicates needs of each factor. By utilizing the affected impacting grid, key components were distinguished. Amid the way toward applying DEMATEL, board of specialists play a corresponding and endorsement part for programming up gradations.

Author Keywords: DEMATEL (Decision Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory)

articleTitle: Analysis of aerodynamic characteristics of a missile configuration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In these project efforts were put to understand the aerodynamic characteristics of medium range Air-to-Air missile. The aerodynamic coefficients were obtained using theoretical methods, wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics. In our wind tunnel we tested a full scale model rocket model. The data obtained was made error free and analyzed using CFD to determine the variation of aerodynamic characteristics at different angles of attack. Various graphs were obtained for different parameters. Further theoretical methods were used to measure a axial force and normal force on missile at different angle of attack. A comparative study of both was carried out. The experimental data obtained were compared with both CFD and theoretical modes and the various non-linearity's were observed and studied. From these the conclusion the competence of the missile that was tested was inferred.

articleTitle: UML/OCL or Object-Z?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: UML/OCL and Object-Z are two technologies complementing each other. They show a “converging” syntax for their basic features, and are distinguished by a “diverging” syntax for their more advanced features. The objective of this paper is twofold. First, we show that for the basic features the mapping between both languages is a comorphism between their corresponding institutions. Second, we identify the advanced features in order to characterize closely the type of a potential mapping between both languages. Our approach is demonstrated through a simple example related to human resources' management in companies.

articleTitle: Wavelet based human voice identification system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This paper investigates the use of wavelet transform in order to remove noise from the signals. One of the ongoing research in multimedia applications is speech signal processing. Wavelet denoising technique is attempted to reduce and remove noise from the audio signal. It is therefore required to transform audio signal to wavelet domain by using discrete wavelet transform followed by denoising algorithm. Both soft and hard thresholding of denoising technique is used to compare the performance of human noise identification. Denoising the signal is performed in the transformation domain and improvement in the denoising will be achieved in various families of wavelet transform. There are several types of wavelets such as Haar, Symlets, BiorSplines, Discrete Meyer (Dmey) and Reverse Biothogonal. In this paper, identification of human noise is verified with Dmey and Fejer-Korovkin wavelets. Comparative analysis is done to calculate SNR after the spectral subtraction. The quality of the audio signal is determined by Mean Square Error (MSE) and Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) of the denoised signal. The simulation results are performed in Matlab program. From the result analysis, it is shown that the Fejer-Korovkin wavelet filter has a better performance as compared to other type of wavelet transform and can be able to identify and differentiate human voices with others.

articleTitle: Non-functional requirement prioritization approach based on historical similar project
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This paper proposes a new Non functional prioritization technique that uses the weighted average of stakeholder weight and their preferences per aspects. The change in usage count and/or dependencies leads to change in priority of requirements and finally the average change in priority are calculated each time there is change in priority. The new project requirements are mapped with existing similar projects, in case of directly mapped, the priorities of similar projects are modified by adding the average change in priority and then assigned as priority of directly mapped requirement of new project. For different requirements, the requirements are prioritized using the weighted average of stakeholder weight and their preferences along with usage and dependency count. The proposed technique is compared with existing non functional requirement prioritization technique and former technique out performs the latter in terms of accuracy and time of computation due to heavy reliance on values of historical similar projects.

articleTitle: Design of an array antenna for 5G wireless network with enhanced bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: An approach has been taken to achieve a circular polarisation (CP) coaxial feed patch antenna array includes an array with wide band axial ratio. The antenna is used to broaden the impedance bandwidth. In this paper the antenna geometry includes an array of rectangular patch at the centre. The corner slots are responsible for circular polarization as well as area reduction. FR4 substrate is used for the design having dielectric constant of 4.4 and size of 30mm×30mm×1.6mm. The measured results include 10dB impedance bandwidth for multiband frequency range at 5GHz, 9GHz, and 15.5GHz of 620MHz, 650MHz and 4.06GHz at centre frequency of 5GHz. The return loss is of −20db, −15.5db and −17db. The results are well in tune of the proposed design and can be suitably applicable for next generation wireless communication and digital radio system.

articleTitle: Sentiment analytics framework integrating Twitter and Odoo ERP
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Microblogging are examples of sources of Big Data. Big data Analytics, such as sentiment analytics, can be applied on microblogging to analyse what is currently happening. However, the provision of near real-time analytics using Big Data is still a challenge. Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems commonly operate using a central relational database. The ERP database acts as a hub to organise structured data that are collected mostly internally via different business transactions that are recorded regularly in the ERP database. With the advent of Big Data analytics, new research directions have been set regarding ERP and Big Data integration; one of them being ERP analytics. Additionally, there are limited research available related to the integration of ERP and sentiment analytics. Therefore, the motivation of this work is set in this direction and a framework is proposed which integrates ERP, microblogging and sentiment analytics. Twitter has been used as microblogging. It was found that the accuracy drastically increased with no irrelevant tweets retrieved when using hashtags. Moreover, the proposed framework observed an improvement in processing time when adding additional nodes.

articleTitle: An app for language learners
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Due to the globalization of things these days, learning different languages is very important.
