The best way to learn/improve a language skill is to practice by getting involved in communities and interacting with people. Learning a new language is fun, interesting and can open a lot of opportunities. While you are learning a new language, you will be exposed to the culture of the people speaking that language. This will broaden your point of view about the world. You will be exposed to new experiences which will enrich your knowledge. Communicating in one language (even it is a language that is widely used) is not enough in this competitive and business globally oriented environment.

articleTitle: Contour design of aerospike nozzle and comparison of performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This Paper has been excavating and investigating two different types of Aerospike nozzles such as external aerospike nozzle and internal-external aerospike nozzle. The main reason for using aerospike nozzle over bell nozzle is automatic altitude compensation. With the help of Method of characteristics and MATLAB codes, geometry of both the nozzles has been created in GAMBIT and flow analysis has been carried out in FLUENT for desired exit Mach number. Analysis has been carried out for both types of nozzles with different truncations. However, in this paper the fuel was taken as Papi 94 and Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) with N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O as an oxidant and the combustion products were entered in FLUENT by selecting species transport. The desired exit Mach number resulted in FLUENT is compared to the designed exit Mach number in code for both the two nozzles and their truncations.

articleTitle: Clustering and ranking social media users based on temporal analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Temporal information retrieval is widely used to organize the data according to the time considerations. Social media has rapidly changing time varying content. Temporal information retrieval has made it easy to explore this kind of dynamically changing content. Clustering involves grouping the data in such a way that their inter cluster similarity is low and intra cluster similarity is high. Similar set of data belongs to a single cluster making analysis of data easier. In this work, relevant features are extracted from the Social Media platform `Facebook'. These features form the basis for ranking and clustering of users. Proposed ranking technique involves the temporal dimension of data and comments by different users. Data mining toolkit WEKA is used for clustering. Three algorithms used for clustering are: XMeans, Expectation Maximization and Hierarchical. Comparison of results for these algorithms shows that XMeans and Expectation Maximization are better for Social Media based Temporal data rather than hierarchical clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Fuzzy rule base solution of Bi-criterion software release time problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The demand of highly reliable software systems has resulted in rigorous testing of the software. A major part of the software development cost is assigned to the testing phase. Now a day, along with the development cost, the maintenance cost during the warranty period is also included in the cost function. The optimal release time prediction is the biggest concern of the software development team. In recent times many models have been developed. Most of the work done in the literature for determination of Software release time problem focuses on crisp optimization problem. This paper discusses the bi-criterion release time prediction using fuzzy Logic, considering testing cost and reliability in the objective function and time as constraint. The problem is solved by using the concepts of fuzzy logic. The optimization problem is validated on the real dataset, results are compared with models described in literature review and results of proposed fuzzy rule base model are appreciable as compared to existing models.

articleTitle: Rule based sentiment analysis system for analyzing tweets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In daily life, our beliefs and perceptions of reality are largely dependent on how other people analyze the world. People mostly share their opinions about different entities like organization, products, services etc. on social media, forums, and blogs. It's very difficult to analyze this enormous amount of data manually. Thus, sentiment analysis is the process which automatically identifies people's attitudes and emotional states. In this paper, sentiment analysis system has been proposed which computes the sentiment and score of each tweet extracted from Twitter about any parameter given by a user. The proposed system has achieved an accuracy of 86% in case of testing on 500 tweets and 94% while testing on 200 English sentences. The results given by the system are very stimulating and in future, it has potential to be used for the benefits of society.

articleTitle: Hybrid artificial intelligence model based on neural network simulation models for software maintainability prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Software maintenance is a procedure of adapting a software system or module after dispatch to correct errors, expand performance or other properties, or familiarize to a transformed circumstances. We can say that Software maintenance can consume as much as 92% of the over-all exertion expended on a system in its life-cycle. For prediction of software maintenance, we need specific tool or methodology that helps us in prediction of software maintenance, one of the world wide accepted tool is prediction by using Maintainability Index, keeping in a view that software applications will be more maintainable. We can also go for risk analysis phase to calculate cost factor analysis. Therefore the design team may be call for designing a more reliable design while predicting the MI in early phase of development of the software.

articleTitle: Computerized paper evaluation using neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In today's world on one hand where the computer has revolutionized the field of education and on other hand there are still some areas where there is a need of use of computers. Traditional ways of checking have various kinds of faults. There are several mistakes that occur on the checking department's side like totaling error, marking mistake and sometimes there can be partiality in evaluation of marks. For any student the evaluation of the exam plays an important role. The students are generally classified on the basics of their performances in the examination. Therefore the assessment of examination should be carried out in a most efficient way. Current evaluation process leaves the future of the student at the mercy of the teachers. The understudies likewise don't motivate chances to express their insight and potential. Rather they are made to take in the stuff they had already learnt in their individual reading material. These variables upset the imagination of the understudies all things considered. Likewise a lot of cash and time is squandered. The practice of current evaluation system is used widely across the world and student s across all the areas have been facing the drawbacks of this current evaluation system. The advance of separation training has likewise been hampered by the non-accessibility of an automated assessment framework. This paper tends to how these striking insufficiencies in the instructive framework can be evacuated.

articleTitle: Comparison and selection of SaaS service providers using ASMAN framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In this paper, we used ASMAN [Appropriate Selection of SaaS Model According to Needs] framework for evaluating certain parameters of quality [cost, speed, availability, usability, reliability]. We first accept the user request by input certain parameters and then, make a comparison among SaaS service providers based on user requirement. This framework converts the results into List class array format then sends the comparison search results data list to controllers. Controller creates comparative view and sends the response to user. This framework helps in selecting software as a service provider among available SSP's.

articleTitle: An efficient influence based label propagation algorithm for clustering large graphs
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Representing data in the form of graph offer a very powerful way to provideprimitive representations for many applications spanning from biological networks, web networks to social networks. In the current era of Big data, size of the graphs is growing exponentially. Clustering large graphs can provide useful insights about graphs. In this paper, an efficient influence based Label propagation algorithm (ILPA) is proposed for clustering large graphs from big data applications. The proposed algorithm stabilizes the tradition LPA to make it computationally less expensive. The proposed ILPA starts by labeling only those vertices that have high influence in network and set them as cluster centers. Further, the selected cluster centers spread their influence by passing it's label to the neighboring vertices. In the end, the vertices with same label are gathered together to form a cluster. The performance evaluation is carried out on two real life graph datasets. It is shown that the proposed ILPA outperforms the state-of art clustering algorithms in terms of Modularity and F-Measure.

articleTitle: Economic hurdle for implementation of cloud computing in higher education in Sultanate of Oman
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a buzz word in the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century that promises to provide computing as a utility service like electricity, water and internet. Due to growing demand of computing services in organizations IT world has witnessed extensive deployment of information systems, servers, networks and related technologies during past several decades. As the complexity of services has increased, the management cost, administrative overhead, availability and reliability have become key areas of concern. Moreover, the recurring cost on software and hardware is one more significant reason for organizations especially education institutions to think of an alternative. Cloud Computing provides a suitable solution to many of the aforementioned problems. However, there are reservations in organizations related to the security and privacy that are associated with cloud infrastructures. Implementation of a private cloud in an educational establishment can yield enormous benefits not only to students and faculty members but to all the stakeholders of the establishment. As private clouds are mostly in-house maintained so there are much lesser concerns related to the security and privacy as also analyzed that very few higher educational establishments all over the world have implemented private clouds. Although private clouds for higher educational establishments can be very beneficial, the possible reasons for its less implementation is an important question that needs to be explained. This paper is an effort in this direction to analyze the economic barriers that effect and hamper the implementation of private clouds in higher education institutions in Sultanate of Oman.

articleTitle: Unified ontology for data integration for tourism sector
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Tourists nowadays have to overcome a wide range of challenges whilst making their itineraries due to the necessity of sorting through many different sources of information. To assist them throughout the process, we have developed an ontology called Touringology. Ontologies have been utilized to bolster both web specialists thinking and human basic leadership. In spite of the fact that ontologies had been created with regards to Semantic Web, it is the Web 2.0 substance that is really inescapable on the web. Thus, an ontology is required to make target areas with difficulties in performing a certain task. Here, we are targeting the tourism area. Different Ontologies are an intense learning base that have been widely utilized to speak to the different tourism ideas. These Ontologies can then be additionally coordinated to deal with the genuinely necessary prerequisites of settling the heterogeneity issues emerging in e-tourism. However, this incorporation of Ontologies may confound the entire assignment of simplifying the visual aspects of the important e-tourism information. This paper gives an ontology, Touringology that will enable the tourist to simplify their travel plans thus making their stay at the desired location more enjoyable. Touringology will provide the tourist information about the accommodation facilities, food facilities, attractions and transportation facilities available in the desired area.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Audio visual automatic speech recognition using multi-tasking learning of deep neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract:

By Abhinav Thanda and Shankar M. Venkatesan
In ArXiv, 1701.02477, September 2016


Training of two or more tasks over shared representation involves in the Multi-task learning (MTL). In audio-visual automatic speech recognition, multi task learning is applied in the present work. Primary task of MTL is to learn mapping between frame labels obtained from acoustic GMM/HMM model and audio-visual fused features. An auxiliary task which maps frame labels obtained from a visual GMM/HMM model to visual features is combined with frame labels obtained from acoustic model and audio-visual fused features. Results of a base-line hybrid DNN-HMM AVASR model are compared with MTL model which is tested at various levels of babble noise. Results of this paper indicate that MTL is useful at higher level of noise. Comparison with the base-line model, at −3 SNR dB approximate 7%o relative improvement in WER is reported.

articleTitle: Optimizing search query using feature thesaurus and optimizaton tool
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Search Query can be anything that we want to search on internet. Optimization refers to reducing the time in which we get the result of our search. This paper talks about the model based on feature thesaurus, an optimization tool and a Bayesian filter. Feature thesaurus will be created from the original dataset. Optimization tool will process the query depending upon the category, result from the created feature thesaurus and optimization tool will then be processed to the Bayesian filter. This paper discusses about how the search query is optimized and how it affect the search result.

articleTitle: A bat algorithm for job scheduling in ceramics production lines
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The wide array of products manufactured in ceramics production lines and their manufacturing limitations fall into the job scheduling environment. Task scheduling involved in this problem's variant has already been solved by several authors' approaches [1]. That said, this paper intends to propose the use of a relatively new metaheuristics called bat algorithm [3] (BA) to solve such scenarios. Our study includes a numerical experimentation process which confronts the proposed BA algorithm against a Genetic algorithm [2] and a GRASP algorithm [1].

articleTitle: Fusion of local and non-local filters for denoising MRI images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a well-known medical imaging modality. At the time of image acquisition, noises and other artifacts get added to the MRI images. One among the noises which degrade the quality of MRI images is additive noise. Several spatial and transform domain algorithms are developed for additive noise removal from MRI images. All the methods suggested have their own pros and cons. Fusion of two or more denoising algorithms has become a topic of interest nowadays. In this paper, we focus on fusion of two well-known denoising approaches, namely local and non-local filtering concepts for MRI images. Here, we have implemented a local fuzzy filter and the basic Non Local Means filter (NLM). The two approaches are fused in transform domain using Non Subsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT) for denoising a set of MRI images corrupted with additive noise. Experiments have shown that the fusion approach outperforms the individual filtering methods.

articleTitle: Fgv MO-ADDOFL: Multi-objective-based adaptive dynamic directive operative fractional lion algorithm for data clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Data clustering is a process that partitions the data and groups them together in groups based on their similarities and the dissimilarities existing between the data points. The concept to improve the clustering performance and to manage the imprecise and unbalanced data, this paper proposes a Multi-Objective-based Adaptive Dynamic Directive Operative Fractional Lion algorithm (MO-ADDOFL). The fitness is based on the inter-cluster distance, intra-cluster distance, and the cluster density. The fitness proposed newly in this paper enhances the quality of the clusters and improves the classification accuracy. The MO-ADDOFL operates with the maximum fitness measure and determines the optimal centroid for clustering the data points to form the optimal clusters. The proposed algorithm inherits the advantages of the fractional theory. The experimentation is performed using two benchmark datasets, such as lung cancer and Pima Indians Diabetes dataset, which proves that the classification accuracy of the proposed method is better compared with other clustering algorithms. The maximum classification accuracy of MO-ADDOFL is found as 0.84, for the Pima Indians Diabetes dataset.

articleTitle: Design of compact wearable antenna for bandwidth enhancement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This paper aims to design and develop an Octagonal Patch wearable antenna with enhanced bandwidth. Such devices can be used as a radiating tool for sensors or devices mounted on human body for wireless communication to a remote server in many different applications. The device can be useful on providing healthcare or sports science or security related information of any subject carrying such devices to off-body agents in case of emergency. The proposed patch is modified for better bandwidth and efficiency in the current scenario. The proposed design shows better result than the state-of-art design methods in this field.

articleTitle: Optimization technique for networked control DC motor with network-induced delays and noise
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: An industrial control with the network environment faces the data transfer interrupt or disturbances due to noise generated by the machinery's vibration and heavier components. Even though there are enough advantages over network in a closed loop system to control and automate in distant locations. In contrary effect on the poor performance and unstable system behavior due to delays in the network, missing of data and noise is major alarms in Networked Control System (NCS) design. Hence it motivate in developing a suitable controller for NCS, which could overcome the network deficiency. Speed control of a DC motor is developed under a noisy networked environment. A strategy to control and trail the speed of the DC motor in the transport medium with network noise and delays. The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is implemented for its simplicity in implementing and no gradient data is needed to resolve an array of data under various optimization problems. To optimize the PID controller a new technique such as PID - PSO is employed. The effectiveness of planned controllers for networked DC motor is synthesized by simulation and compared with various controllers as PID, Fuzzy-Modulated PID (FMPID), Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC), NARMA-L2 Controller and Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Controller (ANFC).

articleTitle: Smart and connecting city parking — Leveraging lot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In today's world, the popular technology is Internet of Things (IoT). The moto of IoT techies is to make the hectic life of people a bit more easy and comfortable. The smart cities came into existence due to IoT. In the present scenario, Iot is a boom in the field of technology. It is primarily based on machine-to-machine communication (M2M). The smart parking system is also a gift of IoT. Now a day's unusual parking service could not fulfil the increasing call for of car parking. In this paper, we present an smart parking system primarily based on ZigBee and SKY65336 front end module. We have worked on ZigBee as ZigBee is short-range communication system, which is energy efficient. In this proposed paper, the real-time automobile car position and ZigBee coordinator that is equipped in parking lot gets updated every second. Further, we have enhanced the range of the ZigBee wireless technology with the help of SKY65336front end module.

articleTitle: List of keynote/invited speakers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Data mining on social networks for target advertisement in automobile sector
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: There is huge potential to predict hidden social ties between different people sharing common area of interest or common friends. This paper presents data analysis on social network data for target advertising of the automobiles. The interrelated groups are derived from client's interaction data in social networks. Based on these cohesive subgroups, the likelihood of client's preference of a product category is inferred. Using this information, we construct a targeted advertising system. The experimental results on the social network dataset yields better quality of advertisement.

articleTitle: Scheduling and optimizing security technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This research mainly focuses on the attacker model associated with cognitive networks. The attacker model for this paper will be structured using an intervention attribute, which explicates the possible implication an intrusion can have on an individual node in a network. The study will also incorporate security mechanisms into cognitive network fundamentals. The proposed solution includes elements of the Byzantine Failure Model, an integer-programming model and a Python decision tree algorithm. The Byzantine model is a system attribute that ensures it can detect elements within it that have been compromised to give misleading output. The use of Python machine learning algorithms is to ensure that security parameters are fluid and can preempt attacks before they happen. Trust is taken into consideration, which focuses on various attributes of information security The algorithm can be used to provide some lightweight security in the world. To the best of our knowledge our work is first of its kind providing ingrained security feature in Cognitive networks.

articleTitle: Advanced rocket propulsion techniques for deep space travel: A review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: More than 90 years ago, Robert Goddard was the first to test the first ever liquid-fueled rocket, and these types of rockets are still our prime machines to travel vast distances. But the conventional methods for rocket propulsion will be redefined soon enough. This paper discusses different rocket propulsion techniques for deep space travel such as electrically powered spacecraft propulsion and nuclear propulsion.

articleTitle: A ternary subdivision scheme for generating trigonometric splines and its application to geometric modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In this paper, we present a ternary non-stationary subdivision scheme for generating trigonometric splines of order n with uniform knots. As a particular cases for n = 3 and n = 4, we obtain ternary subdivision schemes for generating quadratic and cubic trigonometric splines respectively. These schemes, at every level retain all the points of the previous level if the initial control points lie on the graph of a function which is a linear combination of cos((n-1)x) and sin((n-1)x).

articleTitle: Scale development and factorial analysis of shared leadership in the context of Indian IT sector
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This research paper explores the factors of shared leadership in IT sector in India. A reliable and a valid scale for the measurement of shared leadership (Scale for Measuring Shared Leadership, S.M.S.L) is therefore developed as the previous researches brought to light the requirement of such scales which relate to the Indian IT sector. Attempt is made to reduce large number of variables, studied in relation to the shared leadership from various books and research journals, to few workable factors and analyse how the factors so derived explain the latent construct of shared leadership in the context of IT sector in India. The paper also explores the factors of shared leadership using the factorial analysis of the data collected from teams working in the IT sector in India. It is a team level study of Shared Leadership in IT sector with focus on obtaining the factors using factor analysis method on IBM SPSS. The various variables by which researchers have tried to explain the construct of shared leadership were collected from secondary sources which were then used to develop a questionnaire. The questionnaire was pilot tested and its reliability and validity was evaluated thereafter. Data collected was put to factor analysis through SPSS software to obtain the factors explaining the shared leadership construct in the context of the Indian IT sector. Numerous variables were reduced to few factors. With their help, the Shared leadership in IT sector could be explained as a construct. The findings of this paper also include explanation of the variations in the construct of shared leadership in IT sector and which factors contribute in what order to these variations.

articleTitle: Influence of radiative heat on progress and decline of sonic waves with internal state variables
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In the current research work, idea of sonic-irregularitiesin fluids with internal state-variables is generalized. During course of discussions, only the properties of singular surfaces have been used. An attempt has been made to discuss the influenceof radiative heat term on progress and decline of sonic waves. Velocity propagation is obtained and discussed. The critical-volume/size of (press or force into a smaller space) disturbance is serious and stubborn and it is decided that any (press or force into a smaller space) wave with initial volume/size greater than the critical one, will grow into a shock-wave while any (press or force into a smaller space)-wave with an initial volume/size less than the critical one will result in a ruined state In this paper we will find out the effects of radiative heat transfer on the growth and decay of sonic waves propagating with internal state variables. The radiative heat transfer term can be neglected except in the boundary layer region. We consider an optically thick gas with such a high temperature and low pressure that the radiation pressure number is not negligible but the profiles structured by radiant heat transfer are assumed to be imbedded in the discontinuities.

articleTitle: Web branding harmonizer: Need of color harmonies and its solution in website development
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Color influences our lives in a significant manner. From contrasting to comparing, everything revolves around color. With the boost of appealing websites, choosing colors that are appealing to both the developer and the users is rather challenging. Harmonizing colors for any web page has always been a difficult task for web developers. The authors have developed a website to facilitate web developers for creating different color contrasting harmonies for their website. Web Branding Harmonizer will provide the color harmonies according to the color models. Furthermore, it will also provide Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) to the user to attach it to their respective website.

articleTitle: Data mining and web-based reporting software for power, IR drop and EM analysis in VLSI design
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: VLSI chip complexity keeps increasing due to Moore's law. Power, IR voltage drop and EM analysis become the essential tasks to a successful VLSI design. With so many devices, simulation corners and operation conditions, designers need to check carefully and fix every issue in Power, IR voltage drop and EM analysis report files. It is a timing consuming and error prone process if done by eyeball checks for thousands of lines and many report files. We developed the software to do the data mining on Power, IR voltage drop and EM analysis report files. The output formats are two-level web pages and concise forms for users to review tables of key statistics and graphical map files from analysis results. This paper presents the research work in the data mining or data warehousing applications that collect, sort and manage big data from multiple sources to a central form in order to make the wise decision for VLSI power distribution network designs.

articleTitle: OOMT — Object oriented metric technique towards predictive & qualitative software
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In product improvement condition, the question arranged measurements plays the fundamental part. The question situated measurements are being utilized to assess the nature of the product item and can anticipate the deformities of the item which can't be conceivable in the customary measurements in light of the fact that the conventional measurements are utilized for the most part for organized arranged programming worldview. An Object arranged measurements is an estimation apparatus for the question situated worldview to help speedier advancement. In this paper, the diverse protest situated measurements are explored followed by the proposed techniques from various other works. These measurements are connected to immaculate protest situated dialect (C++ and Python), then getting ready to discover the multifaceted nature of these measurements. The factual qualities are figured and decide the exact quantitative examination for C++ and Python.

articleTitle: Decision aspect prioritization technique for incremental software
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In each incremental version of agile, the requirements are chosen by rating requirements against different decision aspects such as cost, time, business value etc, selection of aspects varies from company to company. There are various techniques to prioritize requirements but limited are available that handles decision aspects are selected. As decision aspects are large in number and as all are not that equally important; there is a need to prioritize decision aspects. Thus, this paper seeks to propose an efficient decision aspect prioritization technique that uses data from previous successful projects and tries to identify the basic aspects i.e. whose values tend to remain same and the dynamic aspects i.e. whose values tend to vary from project to project leading to optimal prioritization.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic modelling of quasi steady stall using neural-network based Gauss Newton method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The maximum likelihood estimators are commonly used in the estimation of aerodynamic model coefficients but, their performance depends on the initial guess values and the noise level of the data. Some of its variants are iterative in nature hence, computational cost is higher. An alternative investigation is performed with the artificial neural network (ANN) where an accurate non-linear mapping is produced with the input-output dataset. And further, the trained network is utilized in the Gauss-Newton based optimization process to estimate the optimal paramters. Our objective of the research is to produce an optimal neural network for non-linear mapping of the quasi steady stall data of aircraft and further, used it to estimate the aerodynamic coefficients. Finally, the validation of the estimates is presented with their Cramer-Rao bounds.

articleTitle: The design and modeling of wideband calculable standard rod-dipole reference antenna for broad bandwidth applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Wideband calculable standard Rod-Type reference dipole antenna for broadband wireless applications was proposed with simple antenna geometry. Single dipole with length resonant at 1.3 GHz was used to cover the 700MHz to 3.5GHz frequency range because of its suitable broadband characteristics. The antenna is feed with two coaxial at centre of half wavelength dipole through the hybrid balun. The bandwidth and frequency band of this calculable dipole can be controlled by changing the antenna dimensions. The antenna design and implementation procedure are explained, design results are discussed that single half-wavelength dipole with balun cab be cover wide bandwidth. Antenna module was simulated on Ansys HFSS and validity of this design is confirmed by comparing measured and simulated results. This antenna is more applicable for the EMI/EMC applications.

articleTitle: Alturjoman Alsagheer: Basic language app for kids
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: We implemented an application that teaches Arabic children the basics of the languages; English, Spanish and German. The application teaches the children the alphabets, basic words and basic phrases. In addition, it uses voice recognition and image recognition to provide the user with fun and beneficial learning experience. The application tests the kids using a simple quiz to test what they have learned.

articleTitle: Rendering trustability to semantic web applications-manchester approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The Semantic Web today is a web that allows for intelligent knowledge retrieval by means of semantically annotated tags. This web also known as Intelligent web aims to provide meaningful information to man and machines equally. However, the information thus provided lacks the component of trust. Therefore we propose a method to embed trust in semantic web documents by the concept of provenance which provides answers to who, when, where and by whom the documents were created or modified. This paper demonstrates the same using the Manchester approach of provenance implemented in a University Ontology.

articleTitle: Cloud application integration methodology using enterprise application integration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Cloud computing and its related services have attracted many organisations to switch on to this model in lieu of, or complementing their existing on-premise solutions. However, with Cloud application integration there are still various challenges to provide Cloud integration. This paper provides a brief review of Cloud application integration concepts including Enterprise Application Integration (EAI). A Cloud Application Integration Methodology using EAI is then proposed to counteract the challenges identified. The new components in the methodology include data governance and an agile approach in the Design and Build phases of the methodology. The proposal is validated using a business case scenario and the outputs are discussed and evaluated to determine the validity of the methodology.

articleTitle: ETHICS and SSM — A critical human element evaluation in software engineering using the NIMSAD framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Methodologies are order of steps or stages that are time dependent and they occur from academics, industrial, business and consultancy companies. They can be basically classified into categories of systems which one prefers to work on. Methodologies can be provision oriented that aims to improve the efficiency of operations but are generally difficult to evaluate to be applied for a particular `problem situation' that they face. A framework is basically independent of methodology that enable the user develop critical and analytical skills while solving problems. NIMSAD is such a framework that helps us to understand problem-solving, evaluate methodologies and assist in evaluating industrial/business practices. They provide a common frame of reforming. The aim of this paper is an attempted evaluation of two such primary methodologies named ETHICS (Effective Technical and Human Implementation of Computer based Systems) and SSM (Soft Systems Methods) using the NIMSAD (Normative Information Model-based Systems Analysis and Design) framework. The evaluation of the methodologies at every stage using the framework renders an effective understanding of the strength and weaknesses of both the methodologies politically and ethically even in an ill structured situation in an organization.

articleTitle: Evaluation of imbalanced learning with entropy of source code metrics as defect predictors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This paper evaluates imbalanced learning algorithms with entropy of source code metrics as predictor variables. Four open source software systems are studied. These systems are ECLIPSE JDT, EQUINOX, MYLYN and ECLIPSE PDE UI. The results of this paper indicate that imbalanced learning algorithms perform better than classical learning methods in terms of Recall, G-mean 1, G-mean 2 and F-measures. For recall measure Condensed Nearest Neighbor rule +Tomek links (CNNTL) perform best, for G-mean 1, G-mean 2 and F-measure Random undersampling (RUS) perform best.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Microcontroller based smart mobility management using fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: This paper describes the use of fuzzy logic and microcontroller in transport system for enhancing the use of public transport and reducing private vehicle usage for environmental protection. Major cause of air pollution is due to the use of fossil fuel, so this paper describes optimal and efficient usage of the private and public transportation system. In the present study On Board Diagnostics — port II is used to gather data from the car like distance travelled and the fuel consumption for each data. These data is fed to the microcontroller to process the data and fed to the fuzzy logic control module where the data are further processed and analyzed. As a result the processor guides the passenger to use the mode of transport, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission on daily basis and the other options like simple mode of transport like bicycle and the possible calories that can be burnt.

articleTitle: Analysing the influence of the DCBF data structure on the DoS attack detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: One of the most common threats to internet security is the Denial of Service attack. There are numerous methods and protocol changes in an effort to detect them. The most common DoS attack detection method relies on the number of the TCP control packet in the network flow. The Bloom filter represents a space efficient data structure that is commonly utilized to detect matching pairs. There are multiple algorithms for the DoS attack detection based on the Bloom filter. The SACK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> algorithm uses the SYN/ACK - ACK matching pair detection with the Bloom filter data structure. The false positive error introduced by the Bloom filter influences on the matching pair detection in the algorithm. The improved SACK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> algorithm significantly reduces the false positive error by replacing the Counting Bloom Filter (CBF) data structure with the Dual Counting Bloom Filter (DCBF) data structure. This improvement significantly improves the matching pair detection. It is expected that the false positive error should influence on the detection of the DoS attack. In this paper, the experimental study is performed to analyse this influence. This study confirms the correlation between the false positive error and the DoS attack detection.

articleTitle: MOM: MANETS (Mutual adjustment by neighbor nodes ensuring transmissions smoothly) on MANets (mobile ad hoc networks) provisioning quality of service at network layer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In this paper the researchers have worked determinedly to create the clique of the best performing nodes by computing their respective degree of trust to each other w.r.t. Degree of Centrality (DC), Battery Power (BP) and other Route Involvement Activities (RI) in the form of multicast groups. Higher is the Trust value (T) more probable protagonist it stages to get engaged in route and its maintenance related activities. The algorithm is highly influenced by the civic and organized nature of all living species in the form of groups on the earth to tranquilize and ease each other's existence and stimulation. The MOM algorithm's modus operandi although abstracts approximately more time, initially to pick the momentum of route building (being novice to the underlying environment) including searching best possible intermediate nodes along with nominating two guarantor nodes for each selected node to replace/assist it when needed but once taken over, route is automatically roped dynamically for all the adaptations. This local approach of load balancing and adapting aptly with route related difficulties or problems, make it a good choice to circumvent the control overhead and instilling the graceful degradation. Hence don't exaggerate the broken links or intermediate nodes unavailability all along the route, through inhibiting re-initiations from the scratch.

articleTitle: Robustness in search-based software remodularization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: In the last two decades, various search-based meta-heuristic optimization approaches to software remodularization problem have been proposed. The main focus of these approaches is mainly to improve the performances of some design quality attributes (e.g., modularity quality, coupling, cohesion, etc.). However, the solution generated after remodularization should also be robust to a good extent. To address the problem, the paper proposes a robust optimization technique for the software remodularization that ensures the generation of the robust solution while maintaining the performances of quality attributes. To this contribution, the original fitness function is redesigned where the concept of robustness is integrated into the performance attributes. The proposed fitness function is incorporated in the design of the Harmony Search (HS) algorithms in order to ensure the proceeding of the remodularization process towards robust search region. Five real-world software projects are remodularized to assess the supremacy of proposed technique. The results are assessed in terms of modularization quality (MQ) and sensitivity and compared with the remodularization solutions obtained without the consideration of robustness in the fitness function. The statistical analysis performed on the obtained results provides sufficient support that the proposed method is able to generate the robust remodularization solution without degrading the quality of remodularized solution.

articleTitle: A conceptual framework on IOT based system designto prevent road accidentsin accident prone cities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Internet of Things in short is connecting physical world to digital world via Sensors, Actuators, Transceivers, Processors and the communication between the devices is achieved throughagglomeration of wireless technologies to achieve some meaningful purposes. IOT has brought an enormous differences in human lives by reducing human interventions with machines. This paper highlights the accident rates across the world as per their ranking as published by WHO. In this paper, A conceptual frame work has been proposed that high lights different causes of road accidents to take place. This paper also covers possible measuring parameters and approaches that draws a solution to prevent road accidents in the light of IOT technology and It also highlights some of the existing technologies that have been used in the transportation area to resolve the problem of traffic accidents and compares it with the proposed method in terms of its limitations.

articleTitle: A lightweight replay attack detection framework for battery depended IoT devices designed for healthcare
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Internet of things can be summarized as all physical objects connected to the Internet and being able to identify themselves to other digital devices, with the intent of facilitating communication that can transform the way we operate. Data integrity in healthcare is of utmost importance. A compromised transmitted or received signal can pose serious health hazards to patients. With the growing number of devices connected to the Internet, serious security concerns have been raised in relation to lack of appropriate security mechanisms used in Internet of Things devices. While security considerations are not recent in the arena of Information Technology, many existing frameworks developed for Internet of Things (IoT)healthcare present new and unique security challenges. In order to address these challenges and ensure a maximum level of security in IoT products and services, a lightweight and reliable framework has been developed which uses a combination of universally unique identifier, timestamp and a self-learning battery depletion monitor to detect and mitigate replay attacks on battery dependent IoT devices. A prototype application has been developed to successfully test the framework.

articleTitle: Routing protocols and security issues in MANET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) is an association of large number of sensor nodes and having self directed commands using the un protected wire less connections. The individual nodes in the network can accompany and leave the network with out any permission. MANET is an infrastructureless network. The network topology is rapidly change due to nodes mobility, resource constraint and bandwidth limitation of wireless medias. This nature of nodes leads to different types of security threats. MANET suffers from disruption so that node not able to take part in path finding methods with a target to spoil the full network functioning. A number of protocols have been found for efficient routing. There are many types of security attacks which disturb the net work operation. In this survey paper focuses of many proposed routing protocols for MANET and types of security attacks and a survey of the existing techniques of detection and prevention of attacks is presented.

articleTitle: Prediction for big data and IoT in 2017
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: A digital network is rising to support the forthcoming digital business and its underlying technology platforms and IT practices. It focuses on folks and therefore the Internet of Things (IoT) endpoints. The digital business evolution is exploiting new digital models to align additional closely to the physical and digital world for workers, partners and customers. Technology is frozen in everything. Digital technologies in the likes of cellular devices, social media platforms, smartphones, big data, prognosticative analytics, and cloud etc seem to be completely different when compared to the preceding IT-based technologies. Newer technologies bit the purchasers directly which interaction creates a supply of digital distinction that matters to worth and revenue. The companies are looking for ways that to chop prices whereas at a similar time grow capabilities that are core to their future growth. Historically, Technology strategy was viewed as a value center, but currently organizations formulate technology strategy because it acts as enabler of future business success. Technology helps organizations expedite business outcomes with best-in-class value structures.

articleTitle: Evaluating satisfaction level of grocery E-retailers using intuitionistic fuzzy TOPSIS and ECCSI model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Online buying enables consumers to buy products and services straightaway from the retailers over the internet, with more or less no human interventions. Shoppers find merchandise of their choice, quality, price point by going to these websites of the retailers with just a click of the button. But, Is transparency and competitiveness in pricing and product quality enough for the customers to prefer one vendor over the other? Through this paper we would try to resolve this fuzzy state and try to find the vital aspects of major grocery retailers that are critical for satisfying the buyers. Also, how the competing retailers are utilizing these aspects to differentiate themselves in minds of the people and compete for their share in customer's wallet. In this paper study of the E-Commerce Customer Satisfaction Index (ECCSI) Model is done for understanding the aspects of online customer satisfaction and with the use of Intuitionistic Fuzzy TOPSIS tool different online retailers are studied to map them on the degree of satisfaction level they provide and accomplish their goal to establish themselves in the market place.

articleTitle: Behavioural similarity analysis for supporting the recommendation in PAbMM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The transactions through Internet continuously happen and represents a propitious field for the data stream processing. Moreover, the decision making process associated with the online processing, requires support or knowledge from previous experiences. With the aim of to be more accuracy in the managing and retrieving of the organizational knowledge (or previous experiences), we introduce a model for the behavioural similarity analysis from similar structurally entities based on a measurement and evaluation framework. This analysis is added to the structural similarity analysis in the processing architecture based on measurement metadata for better supporting of the recommendation based on the organizational memory. The behavioural analysis allows limiting the search space of available recommendations in the organizational memory and to be more accuracy for recommending courses of action. It is a key asset in the processing of the measurement streams, on the one hand, before situations in which there not exists specific previous experiences related to an entity under monitoring; on the other hand, considering that the organizational memory is hosted on a big data ecosystem.

articleTitle: Severity measure of issues creating vulnerabilities in websites using two way assessment technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Defects and faults that create vulnerabilities are dangerous for websites. Our major objective is to reduce those attacks on websites by controlling the issues responsible for these attacks. In this paper we have classified those issues into 10 categories and given them precedence according to their severity. These issues have impact which attributes to losses in terms of monetary as well as humanity. By prioritizing these issues, web designers as well as users will check twice on these aspects before entering confidential information into the website. The opinion of different web designers and experts of different companies was captured to prioritize these issues using Analytical Hierarchical Process and Two way assessment methods so that the loss should be minimized. Our findings confirm that total severity measure facilitates the severity of these issue's contribution towards vulnerabilities. Using two way assessment technique we found that there was one such issue which happened to be highly severe and needs urgent attention while designing the websites by web developers and also by customers way ahead of sharing their private information on a website to minimize the losses.

articleTitle: Impact of information technologies on library services in educational institutions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Library and data science is an exceptionally wide impart, which utilizes an extensive variety of continually advancing examination systems and methods. Bureaucrats have a chance to discover better approaches to coordinate accumulations and administrations to tutee needs and institutional objectives by giving assets and programming in Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. With the development of worldwide tutee enlistment in universities, client recognition has turned into a territory of creating research in scholastic libraries. So as to serve these tutee's better, colleges will be required to additionally see how scholastic library administrations are at present seen by global students. The inference is that the utilization of Information innovation in Libraries serves to give better presidencies to the end customer and the supply of information is utilized as a part of a superior route for the improvement of scholarly exercises. The main intention of this paper is to present the outcome of data innovation, mobile application, Radio frequency identification, self-check-out kiosk in the scholastic Amity University Dubai library and depicts the effect of this new innovation on present and future instructive administrations and proposes an engineering that augments the advantages for the organization andfor the global students.

articleTitle: Estimation of software reliability and development cost using interval type-2 fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Much of the work done in regard to reliability estimation of software relates itself to the testing or development phase of the commodity while less attempt has been made to estimate the reliability in the early phase of software development i.e., in the requirement analysis or design phase. Different reliability allocation methods have been used for assigning component reliability goals, which further were used to determine the reliability of the software. The present paper deals in a software reliability allocation model which has been developed based on user's view in regard to various functions constituting the software. Estimating the achievable reliability of the system at the planning or design phase itself makes reliability a singular measure to evaluate system performance. In order to accomplish the aforementioned task, a hierarchical approach has been established for the system in which the user's view has been combined with programmer and manager's view point to allocate reliability of each component followed by reliability allocation of the entire system. Interval Type-2 fuzzy analytical hierarchical process has been used to compute the software's component reliability in each case and a comparison has been put forth with the reliability measures obtained via Type-1 fuzzy analytical hierarchical process. A numerical example has been presented to validate the model based on both the aforementioned processes. Furthermore, considering the idea of efficiency of performance of each component an optimization problem has been formulated which evaluates the optimal cost for developing the software as also determines the optimal reliability the software is capable of achieving.

Author Keywords: interval type-2 fuzzy analytical hierarchical process

articleTitle: Knowledge sharing for agile distributed teams: A case study of Mauritius
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Knowledge is considered as an important factor during software development process as the latter is a people-based activity where developers' and other stakeholders' knowledge impact on the development. Different ways and techniques have been used to share knowledge in agile software development teams. Additionally rigorous, structured and formalized processes have been used to tackle the difficult task of transferring and sharing knowledge in a software teams. Nowadays, with large amount of information being processed within software companies, agile distributed software teams also need to take into consideration the aspects of Big Data while sharing knowledge within agile teams. A survey has been carried out in software development companies in Mauritius to investigate on knowledge sharing methods adopted by agile software development teams. Main findings have been discussed and recommendations have been made.

articleTitle: A big data framework for diabetes in Mauritius
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Telemedicine, Electronic Health Records (EHR) and social media seem to have shown promising directions to deal with diabetes. With the rapid advances in ICT, various diabetes information systems have evolved in the past years. The availability of new technologies for diagnosing, monitoring and treating diabetes is critical to achieve recommended metabolic control. Additionally, Big Data solutions are necessary to meet the massive transformation currently occurring in the healthcare industry. The paper highlights the current status of diabetes in Mauritius. Additionally it analyses some existing solutions for diabetes management. The paper also discusses the challenges of Big Data in healthcare and proposes a Big Data framework for diabetes mellitus in Mauritius.

articleTitle: A framework of innovation driven eco-system for Dubai
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: His Highness Shaikh Mohammad Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice-President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai held a special Cabinet meeting in November 2014 at Fujairah's historic fort and under the directions of Sheikh Khalifa, the President and the Cabinet designated Year 2015 as the “Year of Innovation”. The intention was to initiate activities at federal government levels that may attract national skills, promote research and development. Furthermore it was desired that a national level cadre be launched that may eventually lead Dubai's future towards more progress, prosperity and innovation. In an attempt to understand what drives innovation in general and particularly within Dubai, this research paper examines drivers of innovation and compares them with top-rated innovative cities of the world. The paper critically reviews steps taken by the Government to make UAE one among the most innovative nations in the world within a 7-year period and as case study examines Small-Medium Enterprises (SMEs) sector, as it happens to be key one of the key performing sectors.

articleTitle: A multi-constraint based objective function and lion optimization for the data clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Data clustering allows partitioning of the large database into smaller databases for improving the data mining. This paper introduces a multi-constraint based objective function for the selection of the optimal cluster centroids for clustering the data. The proposed objective function utilizes three parameters, such as intra-cluster distance, inter-cluster distance, and density, where various kernel functions, namely Gaussian kernel, tangential kernel, rational quadratic kernel and inverse multiquadratic kernel, are used for the distance measure. Then, Adaptive Dynamic Directive Operative Fractional Lion (ADDOFL) algorithm that makes use of proposed multikernel based objective function finds the optimal cluster center. From the simulation results, it is obvious that the ADDOFL algorithm with the proposed objective function has better performance than the ADDOFL algorithm, using the Clustering Accuracy (CA) and the Jaccard coefficient (JC) metrics. For the lung cancer database, the proposed ADDOFL with the multikernel based fitness achieved CA and JC values of 0.8670, and 0.85, for the cluster size of 2. Similarly, for the Pima Indian diabetes database, the proposed ADDOFL with the multikernel based fitness achieved CA and JC values of 0.84609, and 0.85, respectively.

articleTitle: Automated complete test case coverage for web based applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Exhaustive testing is said to be impossible due to the various combinations of test cases possible on a specific page, not considering the whole system. In this paper, the automated testing of all possible combinations for a given page is attempted using a system which was named CRaTCP-'Control Ripper and Test Case Player'. The technique involves: the extraction of all the controls from a given page; the assessment of the validations for those controls; the automatic generation of all possible test scenarios in an excel sheet; and finally executing those test cases on the given page. CRaTCP analyses the page source of a dynamic page and hence is not dependent on the programming language that creates the dynamic page. The system has been tested on custom pages and then has been evaluated against random web pages. The results obtained on the custom pages are promising. All controls were retrieved, with the proper insertion of the various combinations of scenarios into the excel sheet, hence achieving a complete test coverage automatically. This was due to the fact that proper coding standards have been used to implement the custom pages. CRaTCP was also evaluated against some online web pages and the results were satisfactory. Though pages created are very developers' dependent, the script was able to extract the controls and list them in the excel sheet. The results however showed some limitations of the prototype which will be taken up in the next version. With CRaTCP, neither do testers need tomaually create test cases and nor execute them. This does not imply that automation will completely replace manual testing, but will provide adequate support to the testing life cycle.

articleTitle: One-class classification in multimodal biometrie authentication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: Class imbalance is a major challenge in biometrie authentication, particularly in the context of two-class classification, i.e., distinguishing between genuine users and impostors. Traditional classifiers assume near-balanced class distributions and as such they do not work well when the samples of one class outnumber those of the other. Indeed, class imbalance is a common problem in multimodal biometrics, where typically impostor samples are in the order of 500:1 compared to those of genuine users. In this work, we present the use of one-class classification to enhance multimodal biometric performance in the presence of class imbalance. We consider well-known one-class classifiers, such as the Gaussian Mixture Model, k-Nearest Neighbour, etc in learning the user-specific and user-independent descriptions for the biometric decision inference. We conclude that the user-specific approach is powerful in overcoming the within-class sub-concepts problem, which commonly occurs in multimodal biometrics due to user variation.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach to cater for identity and location challenges in crowdsourcing applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: A revolutionary and fairly new paradigm, participatory sensing, commonly known as crowdsourcing, offers individuals and groups of people alike the opportunity to contribute information to an application using their mobile devices. Nonetheless, a crucial challenge that comes with crowdsourcing is the issue of “privacy” which is a major threat to the success of participatory systems. Private data includes anything confidential and sensitive in nature to the user and can range from the user's identity and location to the address of the person. Data should be safeguarded in a way that prevents any unauthorized person from breaking the security mechanisms protecting the data and accessing the private information. This paper presents a hybrid approach to deal with the privacy challenges by creating a security layer which uses a combination of techniques namely encryption, encoding, obfuscation and anonymization to better protect users' privacy in crowdsourcing applications. Moreover, the security mechanism allows the user, instead of the application developer, to choose the desired privacy level. A prototype application has been developed to demonstrate the use of the hybrid security layer and, based on the results obtained, it can be deduced that the proposed hybrid mechanism meets the privacy requirements defined in this paper, thereby effectively protecting the privacy of the users in crowdsourcing applications.

articleTitle: Risks and regulation of emerging technologies in chaotic and uncertain times the case of 3D printing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Infocom Technologies and Unmanned Systems (Trends and Future Directions) (ICTUS)
abstract: The scale, speed, and complexity of emerging technologies (ETs) such as 3D printing (3DP), virtual reality (VR), and the Internet of Things (IoT), among others, creates new risks and uncertainties, and challenges traditional regulation. This work explains how the scope, scale, and speed of ETs affect the public governance of risk (approaches, structure, and tools). It also discusses the main implications of uncertainty regulation of 3DP, also known as additive manufacturing (AM). Finally, it compares the international 3DP regulation practices. To reach these objectives, I reviewed literature from scientific sources through Scopus and non-academic sources using the Infotrac Newsstand database. I also reviewed content from YouTube and independent blogs, and their related comments. The review of these sources suggests that, in the face of ETs, regulators are unable to keep up. This creates a need for a public governance of risk that is more agile, innovative, holistic, flexible, proactive, and responsible. Moreover, regulatory uncertainty affects 3DP standards, intellectual property, and the way 3DP users interact with each other and the technology. Furthermore, the international 3DP regulation practices involve standardization, certification, and creation of 3DP commissions/communities.
